versionChangeAfterRuntime: The release updates version metadata after the approved gameplay candidate.

runtime.recipes: Both ingredient orders produced both results on a temporary board.
runtime.catalystShroom: The land biter was replaced by a friendly PeaHead with 720 body health. Phase was 299 at age 1 and reset to 600 at the shot. The cherry projectile dealt 300 damage.
runtime.cryonicShroom: The land biter became a friendly TallnutHead with 270 body and 2200 helmet health. A separate zombie froze. The frosted helmet was visible.
runtime.pool: Both plants replaced their pool biters with friendly Pail zombies in the water. Cryonic froze the separate zombie in the pool fixture.
runtime.restoration: The test restored the temporary difficulty and original DLL, verified profile hashes and DP-3, and confirmed process exit.

limits: The test sampled the global freeze counter. The full duration, standalone frost immunity and fire weakness were outside the focused gameplay fixture.
The port reuses existing plant, zombie and projectile artwork. The native save and load paths were outside the focused gameplay fixture.
